subject: Procurement requirements: PO fields, invoice cadence, and discount packaging
messages:
From: Samantha Green <samantha.green@pivotal-systems.com>
To: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@pivotal-systems.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Procurement: PO requirements + discount timing

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the call today — quick follow up from Pivotal Systems' procurement team. Before we issue a formal PO we need confirmation on a couple of items so our AP team can map it into our ERP:

- Mandatory PO fields you require (PO header metadata, account code, BU tag).
- Whether Redwood can accept a monthly consolidated invoice vs weekly statements (we prefer monthly).
- How slab discounts are applied if invoices are consolidated (do you apply discounts at invoice level or per-usage line items?).
- Net term options: we typically issue net45 but can do net30 for strategic vendors — curious what you can accept and whether that affects discount eligibility.

Can you share a sample PO and an example invoice layout (so we can check the fields)? Also looping in Raj (finance) for remittance questions.

Appreciate a quick reply — procurement is aiming to finalize by end of week.

Best,
Samantha
Samantha Green
Sr. Procurement Specialist | Pivotal Systems
attachments referenced: pricing-slabs-attachment.xlsx (requested)
From: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@pivotal-systems.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@pivotal-systems.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement: PO requirements + discount timing

Hi Samantha — thanks, great questions. Short answers up front and I attached a sample PO stub and the pricing slab calc sheet for reference.

- Required PO fields: PO number, invoice remit-to (billing@redwood.com), Redwood account id (we'll provide), contract effective date, billing cadence (monthly/weekly), and the HubSpot deal id on the PO (helps automate ledger tagging). If you need our GL code, Vanessa has that.
- Invoice cadence: we can do monthly consolidated invoices, but note that our standard slab discounts are evaluated at the invoice level (total monthly spend). That means monthly consolidation preserves discount eligibility and simplifies reconciliation.
- Discount mechanics: slab tiers are applied to the invoice total for the month. If you split into multiple weekly invoices, discounts will be applied per invoice which can reduce realized discount. We can add a memo line on each invoice showing pre-discount usage by product for transparency.
- Net terms: our default enterprise terms are net30 for committed contracts. For net45 requests we usually require purchase-order-based approval plus an upfront credit check or a small prepay buffer. If Pivotal wants net45 and also to keep the same discount tiers, we can route to Finance for approval; there may be a floor on discount (e.g., larger discounts reserved for net30).

I'm copying Vanessa (payments) and Vivek (sales ops) to confirm GL code and whether we need a legal approval for net45 exceptions. I've attached: sample-po-stub.pdf and pricing-slabs-attachment.xlsx.

Next steps: Raj — if you can send a redline of any required PO fields or the ERP sample, we can confirm. Happy to hop on a 20-min call if helpful.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@pivotal-systems.com>
To: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Samantha Green <samantha.green@pivotal-systems.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T13:09:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement: PO requirements + discount timing

Naomi — thanks for the examples. Quick clarifying Q from AP: our ERP requires a separate remit-to address and a vendor tax id in the PO header. Can you confirm Redwood's remit address and provide the W-9 or tax id we should include? Also, if discounts are applied monthly, we need the discount calculation logic documented for our reconciliation team.

If net45 requires a credit buffer, what form does that take? An escrow, prepay, or a holdback? We want to avoid delays to our internal budget cycles.

-Raj
Financial Operations Lead, Pivotal Systems
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@pivotal-systems.com>, Samantha Green <samantha.green@pivotal-systems.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement: PO requirements + discount timing

Hi all — Vanessa from Billing here. Answers:

- Remit-to: Redwood Inference, Attn: AR, 4200 Redwood Ave, San Francisco, CA 94107 — remit by ACH to account ending in 2345. Billing email for invoice ingestion: billing@redwood.com.
- Tax ID / Vendor paperwork: I'll send our W-9 and vendor setup packet via the secure ShareFile link.
- Net45: Finance will accept net45 under two conditions: (1) we add a 30-day delayed discount clawback clause (i.e., if payments move beyond 75 days we reserve the right to recalc discount) OR (2) Pivotal signs up for a small prepayment deposit equal to 10% of the first month's committed spend. Either option enables net45 while protecting discount economics.
- Invoice format: we can append a per-line 'usage-category' and 'discount-applied' column. For consolidated monthly invoices we will include a summary page that shows invoice total, pre-discount total, and slab discount applied.

I've uploaded W-9 and the vendor packet here: https://redwood-internal.company/finance/po-guidelines#remit (secure link).

Naomi/Vivek — if you want me to accept a soft-net45 in the contract, I can add the clawback language to the vendor terms and mark it as an exception.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Manager, Revenue Billing | Redwood Inference
attachments included: W-9 (W9_redwood.pdf)
From: Samantha Green <samantha.green@pivotal-systems.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@pivotal-systems.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T11:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement: PO requirements + discount timing

Vanessa — appreciate the options. Procurement preference is to avoid prepay if possible; the clawback clause seems acceptable pending legal review. A few follow-ups:

- Can you add the exact clawback wording we can pass to our counsel? Something like: 'If aggregate payments for invoice(s) exceed 75 days past invoice date, Redwood reserves the right to adjust previously applied slab discounts on subsequent invoices to remediate credit exposure.' We need to ensure it's not punitive to our internal controllers.
- For monthly consolidated invoices: please include a CSV export option (we ingest CSV into ERP).
- Finally, please confirm whether a single PO can reference multiple deals (we sometimes create consolidated POs that span multiple HubSpot deal ids). Is that acceptable or do you need a separate PO per deal?

If we get the clawback wording and the CSV sample, procurement can issue the PO today.

Best,
Samantha
From: naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@pivotal-systems.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@pivotal-systems.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement: PO requirements + discount timing

Thanks, Samantha — quick wrap. Vanessa will circulate exact clawback wording and the CSV invoice sample by EOD. To confirm on the PO-per-deal question: we can accept a single consolidated PO that lists all related HubSpot deal ids in the PO header (preferred) — that will let us apply a consolidated monthly slab discount. If Pivotal's ERP requires separate POs, discounts will be evaluated per PO which may shift tiers.

I'll also have Karthik push the net45 exception to Finance for approval; Vivek, can you flag this in the deal so Sales knows discount sensitivity?

If procurement issues the PO today with the deal ids and remit info, Billing will provision the consolidated invoice lane and apply the slab calculation on the first monthly invoice.

Action items:
- Vanessa: send clawback clause + CSV invoice sample (attachment).
- Raj: send PO when ready; include HubSpot deal ids in PO header if consolidated.
- Vivek/Karthik: mark deal with netterm exception and discount floor.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — looking forward to closing this out.

Regards,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
